citation.authors: Milani M, Colombo F et al

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: 83 people with hair loss (androgenetic alopecia or chronic telogen effluvium); 26 men, 57 women
record.design: Randomised, assessor-blinded, 12-week trial of a tablet with hydrolysed marine collagen, taurine, cysteine, methionine, iron and selenium plus drug treatment, against drug treatment alone
record.finding: The supplement group scored higher on a photo-based global assessment at 12 weeks (1.67 against 0.66, p<0.001).
record.note: Not placebo-controlled and not collagen alone: it cannot show collagen helped hair loss. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
